properties.evidence: The decision's backstop refuses a claim without a seat, and seat_for_claim and writes_for_inner refuse session-scoped state, only when identity_is_per_request: when the NEGOTIATED MCP revision is the sessionless one. The door's in-process client negotiates 2025-11-25 (RUST_LOG=info, measured), so the server treats each one-request process as a session that will continue. Liveness of a seat minted by another process is "does that pid exist", and a door process has always exited by the next call.
